cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The caterer still has your wedding date. Sit down before you call the venue, please; I have the changes in order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has someone else got our room?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No one has the room. The building can't be used, but don't cancel the caterer; that's a separate booking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we move into their smaller hall?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The fire reached that hall too. Start with the outdoor reception plan, please. I'll read the available spaces one at a time; you don't have to choose while I'm still explaining.
